scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/frontend && npm run build -w apps/backend && node scripts/verify-build.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/backend && npm run test -w apps/frontend
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run db:migrate -w apps/backend
scripts.db:migrations: npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run db:migrations -w apps/backend
scripts.db:check-schema: npm run build -w apps/backend && node scripts/check-database-schema.cjs
